description: Requests a URL and reports the final status code, redirect chain, response time, content type and size, and which security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options...) are present. 0.002 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: http_check
